hypothesis_source: Direction contract 2026-09-10 plus production-leader dual-regime ablation (run 20260907T124708165810Z): removing a_share_dual_regime collapsed the bundled leader path (annualized -22.59%, drawdown -93.73%). Sequence-1 autopsy stopped the five default pattern streams as selectors. This round tests only 'which days, which leaders' as a daily 选股名单, not a pattern detector.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not a 形态检测器, not a monthly factor, not a decoration of wide VCP / cup-handle / high-tight-flag / launch-pullback. Difference from vcp_leader_breakout: drop 趋势模板, 距年高, VCP structure, market-cap, scoring and exits. Difference from sequence-1 autopsy: build a same-day eligible-not-in-universe book instead of marking unavailable_not_in_frozen_inputs. Frozen thresholds 0.30 / 0.70 / 63 / RS85 are not scanned.
exposure: Training 2016-01-01 through 2022-12-31. Fills and 5/10/20-day labels must not cross 2022-12-31. 2023+ is exposure only if computed. Not a clean holdout.

gate.early_recovery: MA20 breadth < 0.30 and higher than five market sessions earlier
gate.broad_advance: MA20 breadth >= 0.70 and 63-session SH/SZ equal-weight return >= 0
gate.fields: Signal-day and earlier daily closes only. Reuse shipped market_breadth_allowed.

universe.rs: Frozen vcp_leader_breakout cross-section: 0.4*63d + 0.2*126d + 0.4*252d close-to-close, average-tie percentile on that day's valid closes. Reuse shipped trend_context with trend_filter=false.
universe.definition: On a gate-open day, stocks with RS percentile >= 85 that also pass 可交易资格.

eligibility.exclude_st: Instrument name contains ST / *ST / 退, same token rule as shipped build_basic_filter_mask. Historical ST facts are not a published 2016-2022 snapshot; current names are the production proxy.
eligibility.listing_age: Market-session age > 30 (exclude_new_days=30 means age > 30). Age is the count of market-calendar dates in [listing_date, signal_date] using instruments.listing_date and the observed SH/SZ bar calendar. Missing listing_date uses a lower bound of observed valid bars > 30. Weekend-inclusive fact calendars do not cover 2016-2022.

selected: Gate open AND in universe AND eligible.

windows.definition: Signal at session t close; buy next market open t+1; scheduled exit is the open of the 5th / 10th / 20th subsequent market session after entry. Limit-up, suspension or missing bar on the buy session voids the signal (no roll). Limit-down, suspension or missing bar on the scheduled exit makes that window incomplete (no roll). Labels past 2022-12-31 are incomplete.

contrasts.vs_market: Same-window SH/SZ equal-weight observed-price open-to-open (entry oc, intervening cc, exit co). Geometric excess (1+stock)/(1+market)-1. Primary aggregation is signal-day equal-weight: mean of daily means, not pooled.
contrasts.vs_same_day_unselected: On the same gate-open signal days, eligible stocks that are not in the RS>=85 universe. This is a real same-day set, not unavailable_not_in_frozen_inputs. Report date-EW of (selected daily mean net minus unselected daily mean net) and date-EW unselected net excess vs market.
contrasts.aggregation: Primary: signal-day equal-weight of net excess. Appendix: pooled trade mean.

pass_fail.pass: Training 10-day and 20-day date-EW net excess vs market are not systematically negative, AND the same two windows vs same-day unselected are not systematically negative. Not a composite score.
pass_fail.fail: Rewrite only the gate event or only the universe definition (one mechanism), then re-contrast once. Do not scan 0.30/0.70/63/RS85, do not add a pattern detector.
pass_fail.blocked: After that one rewrite the 10/20-day date-EW net excess is still systematically negative vs market, or required daily-bar fields cannot be redefined. Stop this selector; mark the goal 阻塞, not an excellent strategy.
pass_fail.not_claimed: No live qualification, no clean 2023-2026 OOS, no parameter search, no 仓位/资金曲线.

halt: If kline_daily_enriched partitions for 2015-01-05 through 2022-12-31 are missing or empty, write a gap list and publish no invented numbers.
bar_source: data/kline_daily_enriched date partitions; instruments.parquet for names and listing_date.
